description: The quarter-turn winder stair with a 100 mm newel at the inner corner of its turn: the newel occupies x = 1750 mm to 1850 mm, y = 950 mm to 1050 mm, and the winders' nosing lines start on its faces. The first and the last winder are each a quadrilateral whose narrow end is 100 tan 30 mm deep along the newel; the middle one wraps the outer corner of the square, and its narrow end, from one face of the newel to the other, is 100 (1 - tan 30) sqrt 2 mm - deeper than the others. The stair's narrowGoing is the least, and nothing narrows to a point, so there is no FS-LINT-018. The walkline, 450 mm from the pivot, is outside the newel (17.7.4).
